test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 05 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who has been appointed as a brand ambassador of Punyakoti Dattu Yojana?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kichcha Sudeep**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Karnataka **government has appointed Kannada actor **Kichcha Sudeep** as the brand ambassador for its cattle adoption scheme known as ‘**Punyakoti Dattu Yojana**’. 
 
• The announcement was made by **Prabhu B Chavan, Animal Husbandry Minister** 
 
• Punyakoti Dattu Yojana is implemented to encourage people's participation in **cow conservation**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9683d08b359603e600aeb3dd53ac3a0293158e8dc44c75082a638d94f6154088.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
